mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE c.target_type = #{targetType} AND c.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY c.created_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE c.id = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (id, target_type, target_id, author_id, body, parent_id, depth, image_key, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{authorId}, #{body}, #{parentId}, #{depth}, #{imageKey}, NOW(3))
mapper.delete: DELETE c FROM comments c WHERE c.created_at < #{sessionDate} AND ((c.target_type = 'POST' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id)) OR (c.target_type = 'DAILY_ANSWER' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_answers a WHERE a.id = c.target_id)))
